title: music
description: Allows you to control playing music tracks.

trackname.title: trackName
trackname.description: Required. A `string` to specify the track to play. Must be a single word such as `record.cat`.

volume.title: volume
volume.description: A `float` number to specify the volume of the music track.

fadeseconds.title: fadeSeconds
fadeseconds.description: A `float` number that specifies the duration the track fades in or out.

repeatmode.title: repeatMode
repeatmode.description: Optional. An `enum`  that specifies how the music is played. Must be `play_once` (default) or `loop`.
